name: source-key-room-local
yaml:
room:
  room_configurations:
    record:
      egress:
        room:
          audio_only: true
          audio_mixing: 2
          file_outputs:
            - filepath: room.ogg
              file_type: 1
              disable_manifest: true

name: source-key-participant-local
yaml:
room:
  room_configurations:
    record:
      egress:
        participant:
          file_outputs:
            - filepath: participant.ogg
              file_type: 1

name: source-key-track-local
yaml:
room:
  room_configurations:
    record:
      egress:
        tracks:
          filepath: dir.with.dot/track.ogg
          disable_manifest: true

name: source-key-nil-outputs
yaml:
room:
  room_configurations:
    record:
      egress:
        participant:
          file_outputs: [null, {}]

name: source-key-composite-filter
yaml:
room:
  room_configurations:
    record:
      egress:
        room:
          webhooks:
            - url: http://127.0.0.1:1
              signing_key: synthetic-api
              filter_params:
                include_events: [egress_ended]

name: source-key-wrong-protojson-key
yaml:
room:
  room_configurations:
    record:
      egress:
        room:
          audio_only: true

name: source-key-composite-oneof-preset-shape
yaml:
room:
  room_configurations:
    record:
      egress:
        room:
          options:
            preset: 0

name: source-key-track-oneof-storage-shape
yaml:
room:
  room_configurations:
    record:
      egress:
        tracks:
          output:
            s3:
              bucket: synthetic

name: source-key-participant-top-preset
yaml:
room:
  room_configurations:
    record:
      egress:
        participant:
          preset: 0
